description: Full-text search of EU legislation titles via the EUR-Lex SPARQL endpoint. Returns CELEX id, English title and document date. Use when the act is not in compliance_index, or to find related/amending acts.

query.description: Keyword(s) that must appear in the English title, e.g. "cybersecurity certification".

type.description: Optional: restrict to a legal act type.

name: search_legislation
